It is completely understandable that you are feeling upset and left out. Welcoming a new grandchild is a joyous occasion, and it is painful to feel disconnected from your son and his new family, especially when you believed your relationship had healed. 

The first few weeks with a newborn can be incredibly overwhelming and exhausting for new parents, which might be contributing to their silence. Instead of waiting for them to call, you might consider sending a warm, low-pressure message. You could let them know you are thinking of them, congratulate them again, and mention that you would love to visit whenever they feel ready, without any expectations. This shows your support and respects their boundaries during this major life transition, leaving the door open for them to invite you in when things settle down.
